Tailoring Character

The 0A Shawl Lapel is the cleanest and most formal shawl variation:

Softer than any peak lapel.
More balanced than a D-shawl.
Ideal for tuxedos and dinner jackets.
Creates a long uninterrupted vertical line.
Best suited to lapel widths between 9.5 cm and 11 cm, with 10 cm being a classic proportion.
